query: 2026 Florida Republican gubernatorial primary status: Byron Donalds candidacy, opponents, Trump endorsement, polling, competitors dropping out. Who is running against Donalds and what are the polls showing as of mid-2026?
answer:
I've completed the research and provided both a full markdown synthesis and the structured findings. Here's a summary of what I found on the 2026 Florida Republican gubernatorial primary:

**Byron Donalds is the dominant, near-certain frontrunner** (Polymarket ~96%), effectively described as "for all practical purposes, the Republican nominee" as of mid-July 2026.

**Key findings:**
- **Trump endorsement:** Came very early (February 2025, before Donalds even declared) and has been repeatedly reaffirmed.
- **Opponents running against Donalds:** Lt. Gov. Jay Collins (main but distant rival, ~5–9%), investor/activist James Fishback (~8–9%), and former House Speaker Paul Renner (~2%). Eleven Republicans qualified for the Aug. 18 primary.
- **Casey DeSantis** was floated by Ron DeSantis in early 2025 but **never became a candidate**.
- **DeSantis himself has not endorsed anyone**, but his key allies (AG Uthmeier, CFO Ingoglia, Senate President Albritton) broke away to back Donalds.
- **Ballot fight:** Collins is trying to disqualify Fishback over residency; a hearing was set for July 21.
- **Polling:** Donalds leads by ~39–46 points across all pollsters (Tyson 48%, AIF 54%, Fabrizio Lee 54%, Emerson 46%), with no rival above ~9%.
- **General election wrinkle:** A May Change Research poll showed Democrat David Jolly leading Donalds 47–42, though the race is still rated Solid Republican.

**Caveat:** Several of the most favorable polls are GOP/internal or industry-aligned pollsters.

key_facts: Byron Donalds is the overwhelming frontrunner in the 2026 FL GOP gubernatorial primary; Polymarket gives him ~96% to win the nomination (stable July 8-15, 2026).
Trump endorsed Donalds very early — February 2025, before Donalds formally declared — and has repeatedly reaffirmed it.
Ron DeSantis himself has NOT endorsed anyone, but his allies (AG James Uthmeier, CFO Blaise Ingoglia, Senate President Ben Albritton) have broken away to endorse Donalds.
Main opponents: Lt. Gov. Jay Collins (~5-9%), investor/activist James Fishback (~8-9%), and former House Speaker Paul Renner (~2%). 11 Republicans qualified for the Aug 18, 2026 primary.
Casey DeSantis was floated in early 2025 but never became an announced candidate; she is treated as a non-candidate.
Jay Collins filed a legal challenge in late June 2026 to disqualify James Fishback over Florida's 7-year residency requirement; a two-day hearing was set to begin July 21, 2026.
Recent polls: Tyson Group (July) Donalds 48%; AIF (June 3-7) Donalds 54%; Fabrizio Lee (Apr 26-30) Donalds 54%; Emerson (April) Donalds 46% — leads of ~39-46 points, no rival above ~9%.
Primaries are Aug 18, 2026; general election Nov 3, 2026; DeSantis is term-limited. Race rated Solid Republican.
General-election note: Democrat David Jolly is the Dem frontrunner; a May 2026 Change Research poll showed Jolly leading Donalds 47%-42% among registered voters.
